changes.title: Overlay tilt
items: Invitations, hearts, the sleepers' dream bubbles and the little chat bubbles now blur with the world toward the top and bottom of the screen, instead of staying sharp over it
The party witches' chat bubbles sit on the bent ground with them

changes.title: Orbit pickup
items: 💌s circle a creature further out, clear of it
Picking up a happy animal's sigil or a relic's is much easier: it works from further away, and a happy animal near you trots over

changes.title: Party over look
items: When the last soundsystem falls the party is over: the dancefloor switches off tile by tile and the party lights go out in a ripple from home across the map, leaving the moonlit forest
Sleeping animals near you show little 😴 bubbles
